key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI matched the human's institution (contingent access, free endogenous monitoring, graduated sanctions) but lost 4.3 vs 4.6 on ordering and depth — it re-derived the pivotal-marginal logic inside its WHY stage while the human wrote the game down first and owned the equilibrium in one pass ('a shift pays only when I am the exact 8th commitment; the observed failures ARE the equilibrium'), and its institution-failure closure was asserted, not quantified. The v6 routed run closed both gaps as m084 completion-contract outputs: game-write-down first (threshold 8/12, cost 1 vs benefit 3, one-shot), the observed 3- and 5-shift seasons stated AS the equilibrium, efficiency gap 36 vs 8, and an institution-failure check with each vector closed concretely (board-log units, compliant-first sequencing, no-exemption clause); the m007 ruin screen priced the sure 36-forgoed floor and the m019 adversary pass quantified per-vector exposure (one exempted farm reopens the hole for all 12). Residual shared gap: the human's payoff-first trace remains marginally more efficient than the gate machinery.
learning_signal: For recurring under-provision of a threshold public good, the m084 contract must output in order: (1) the game written down first — threshold, individual cost/benefit, one-shot vs repeated — with the observed failure pattern stated AS the equilibrium, never as motive ('laziness' is the payoff table's shadow); (2) the efficiency gap (8 cost vs 36 benefit) as the argument for institutionalizing; (3) mechanism design that changes payoffs, not rhetoric — excludability/contingent access converts a public good into a club good so contribution is a best response, with monitoring endogenous and free and sanctions graduated; (4) an institution-failure check with at least one vector closed concretely (measurement via board-logged units, sanction credibility via compliant-first delivery sequencing, collusion via all-member monitoring, capture via a written no-exemption clause); (5) the ruin floor: what each season costs if nothing is done.
suggested_improvement: Keep m084 native single-route on decide/diagnose/estimate/maximize + adversarial,high_stakes,one_shot signatures with the m007+m019 gate set (router confident=yes); make the game-write-down the FIRST m084 contract line so the equilibrium claim precedes any alternative generation (the v5 ordering gap); add political capture / no-exemption clause as a standing m019 vector for access-based institutions so the adversary pass attacks the new rule's own seams, not only the status quo's.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human baseline executed the registered weakness (abstract; institution failure modes) exactly as designed — it saw the free-rider element (a skip saves 2h while the street stays mostly protected) and answered with fast-tracked formal mechanism design (acclamation ratification, sheet-at-barrier, post-event fines), never pricing stand-up cost against a 36-hour problem lifetime, never noticing its sanctions cannot fire before the crest, ignoring the 6-eyes monitoring already present and the crowding-out of intrinsic reciprocity by fines. The v6 routed run held the protective verdict with quantified machinery: m001 fundamentals+anchor (what does the charter add beyond six neighbors' observation/reciprocity? nothing in-window), m018 steel-manning that survives every design property and dies on every temporal one, m003 inversion's ≥6 ranked failure categories (evening lost, inert sanctions, crowd-out, false assurance, appeals-void, precedent), the m007 ruin screen (charter branch: 100% process cost + 0 deterrence), tempo mode pricing the lost evening, and the insight pass naming the meta-lesson 'the norm is the institution' with the n/horizon cost function.
learning_signal: Institutional machinery has a cost function in group size, horizon, and transaction costs: before endorsing ANY proposed mechanism, run the stand-up test (steps × time vs problem lifetime — if stand-up cost > lifetime, the mechanism is the failure mode), the enforcement-latency test (can any sanction actually fire before the deadline? if not, it deters nothing), the redundancy audit (at small n with mutual observation, the formal monitoring layer adds cost and zero information), and the crowding-out check (does monetizing the act change its meaning and reduce intrinsic effort?). The cheap local action — one call, public roll-call, existing reciprocity — IS an institution and must be named first-class, not contrasted as 'no institution'; defer formalization until the horizon allows its cost to amortize (a post-crisis standing plan).
suggested_improvement: Keep the dual-route m001 + m018 pass with the m003 + m007 gate set and tempo mode on deadline,high_stakes,one_shot + guarantee signatures (negative split verified protective for this family); install the stand-up test (stand-up cost vs problem lifetime, enforcement latency, redundancy, crowding-out) as a standing gate on ANY proposed institution whenever the signature carries a deadline; retain the m084 contract's norm/mechanism dichotomy — the cheap local norm IS the institution — as a mandatory packet line so formalization is priced as a deferred option, never as the default answer.
